description: Runtime budgets for the shipping platform: Windows x86_64 desktop, Godot 4.4+ Forward+. MASTER quality is not budgeted here; it is limited only by what the bake and the close-up need.

reference_hardware.desktop_high: GTX 1660 / RX 5600 class or better, 1080p to 1440p, 60 fps
reference_hardware.desktop_low: Recent integrated GPU (Iris Xe / Radeon 680M class), 1080p, 60 fps with reduced settings

LOD0.use: Cinematics, S+ sequences, close-ups, character select, lobby, victory. Forced on for any cinematic camera.

LOD1.use: Gameplay when the character is large on screen (replays, close serve camera, near-camera players).

LOD2.use: Standard gameplay distance (about 60 to 250 px tall at 1080p).
LOD2.secondary: chains flagged keep_at_lod2 (usually the ponytail or the longest mass only)

lod_switch.metric: projected full-body height in pixels (head top to feet) at the current camera

godot_import.color: VRAM Compressed, high_quality = true (BC7), mipmaps on
godot_import.normal: VRAM Compressed, normal_map = enable (BC5 / RGTC), mipmaps on
godot_import.ilm_mask: VRAM Compressed, high_quality = true, sRGB OFF (linear)
godot_import.sdf: Lossless (no block compression: BC artifacts break the shadow threshold), mipmaps on, filter linear

animation.godot_import: Optimizer on (max_velocity_error 0.01, max_angular_error 0.01, max_precision_error 3). Compression on for gameplay clips; off for sp_* clips so facial and finger detail survives close-ups.

vfx.note: Screen coverage is the fraction of the face's screen rectangle covered by opaque or additive VFX at any frame. The face stays readable.
